craftsmanshipPage.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanshipPage.subtitle: Nine steps, one philosophy: everything by hand.

1.title: Clay & Cement Preparation
1.body: Raw materials are selected and prepared using techniques refined over generations.

2.title: Shaping
2.body: Each tile is shaped by hand or hand-guided press, one piece at a time.

3.title: Drying
3.body: Pieces dry slowly and naturally before firing or curing.

4.title: Glazing & Pigmentation
4.body: Color is applied by hand — glaze for Zellige, pigment for cement tiles.

5.title: Kiln / Hydraulic Press
5.body: Traditional kilns and hydraulic presses give each material its final strength.

6.title: Hand Cutting
6.body: Zellige is chiselled into shape by hand, piece by piece.

7.title: Quality Inspection
7.body: Every batch is inspected before it leaves the workshop.

8.title: Packing
8.body: Tiles are carefully packed to travel safely around the world.

9.title: Worldwide Shipping
9.body: From our workshops in Morocco to projects on every continent.

ourCraftPage.title: How We Make Our Cement Tiles
ourCraftPage.subtitle: Handmade in our factory, one tile at a time.
ourCraftPage.intro: Each cement tile is poured, pressed and finished by hand. These films from our workshop follow the process from mould to finished surface.

1.title: Preparing the mould
1.body: The metal frame and pattern divider are set on the workbench, ready to receive pigment and cement.

2.title: Preparing colors and pigments
2.body: Mineral pigments are mixed into cement paste so every colour in the design is prepared by hand.

3.title: Filling the mould
3.body: Each compartment of the pattern is filled, colour by colour, with a small funnel — the surface of the tile is born here.

4.title: Removing the mould
4.body: Once the pattern is complete, the divider is lifted, leaving the design intact in the wet cement.

5.title: Pressing the cement tile
5.body: The tile is pressed so the decorative face and the cement body become one dense, durable piece.

6.title: Finishing
6.body: Edges and surfaces are checked and finished in the workshop before curing is complete.

7.title: Final product
7.body: The finished tiles — patterns, colours and borders — leave the factory ready for architecture and interiors.
